operations.title: Mellin half-line modes generate the Xi Cauchy boundary in the Euler domain
operations.statement: For Im(z)>1/2, the one-sided logarithmic mode i exp(izu)1_(u>=0) has transform 1/(gamma-z) and lies in the absolutely convergent Euler–Weil domain. Its extended Weil pairing equals the Xi Pick kernel, giving an exact indefinite isometry from source Mellin boundary modes to the Cauchy kernel span without zero-list input.
operations.scope: Exact Euler-domain indefinite comparison; positivity, full upper-half-plane closure, closability, and physical coefficient-Betti realization remain open.

operations.title: One-sided Mellin Cauchy transform and Weil pairing test
operations.description: Fourier-transform the decaying half-line exponential, verify Euler convergence, and compare its Weil Gram form with the divided logarithmic derivative kernel.
